actions.action: Lock sessions without discarding ticket selections
actions.mechanism: Separate screen locking from draft deletion; a visitor-held code permits private resumption without an account.
actions.implementation: Issue a random recovery code before ticket selection. At 90 seconds idle, mask display and stop speech; retain an encrypted local draft for 30 minutes.
actions.check: Pause five minutes, then resume using touch or physical buttons. Verify selections return; incorrect codes and Start new reveal nothing.
actions.risk: Forgotten codes prevent recovery; rate-limit guesses without blocking new purchases.

actions.action: Make reading screens untimed and nonpersonal
actions.mechanism: Separate lengthy explanations from private summaries so reading requires neither repeated activity nor exposure of saved selections.
actions.implementation: Keep generic instructions and ticket descriptions untimed. Hide selections, quantities, and personal details there. Require recovery-code entry to reopen a locked private summary.
actions.check: Compare three-minute reading trials with the current flow: count lost selections, interruptions, and exposed details during scripted visitor handovers.
actions.risk: Visitors may find switching between explanations and protected summaries cumbersome.

actions.action: Isolate new visitors and guard offline confirmation
actions.mechanism: Separate local session storage and explicit purchase confirmation prevent handover leaks and unintended submissions after reconnection.
actions.implementation: Provide Start new on the lock screen; clear navigation and speech buffers. Store drafts locally. Require a fresh, clearly labeled final Confirm; never submit drafts automatically.
actions.check: Disconnect for ten minutes, abandon a populated session, and start another. Test Back, screen-reader history, and reconnection for leaks or unintended purchases.
actions.risk: Offline payment authorization may remain unavailable; preserve drafts rather than promise completed payment.
